requirements.requirement: The system must render triage reasoning blocks in an order where specialty match appears before any quality score content.
The system must always display a pass or fail indicator for the provider triage result.
The system must render specialty match explanation text when specialty data is present in the triage response.
The system must render quality score reasoning only after the specialty match block has been displayed.
The system must handle partial specialty matches by displaying a distinct explanation indicating partial alignment.
The system must display a fail state explanation when the triage result indicates failure.
The system must not render quality score reasoning if the provider fails triage due to specialty mismatch.
The system must gracefully handle missing specialty data by displaying a fallback message indicating unavailable specialty information.
The system must still render quality reasoning if specialty data is missing but quality data is available.
The system must ensure deterministic ordering of reasoning blocks regardless of input order from the backend.
The system must not duplicate reasoning blocks when rendering triage explanations.
The system must handle empty reasoning arrays by displaying a user-visible message indicating no explanation is available.
The system must render reasoning blocks consistently across re-renders without changing order or content.
The system must prioritize specialty match explanation visually (e.g., first position) even if backend marks another block as higher priority.
